column7: 2026-11-04: Payroll build: the upcoming quarter token must use Australian financial-year quarters (year starts 1 July, so Jul-Sep is Q1, Oct-Dec Q2, Jan-Mar Q3, Apr-Jun Q4). User will add it as a separate change; do not add it as part of the {MMM} work.

2026-11-04: grants branch: a later quarter token must use US federal fiscal-year quarters (year starts 1 Oct; Oct-Dec is Q1, Jan-Mar Q2, Apr-Jun Q3, Jul-Sep Q4). User will request it separately; not part of the {ddd} weekday change. Differs from payroll branch (Australian FY, starts 1 Jul).
